name: pi-agent-test-env
description: Evaluate frozen local-agent application cases and the optional reviewed fixture_lookup integration with independent scorers, fresh repeated Pi trials, bounded Docker resources and retained failures; also supports short coding-delegation plans.
author: Denissvgn

claude_code.discovery_status: documented layout; CLI unavailable, discovery unqualified

codex.discovery_status: workspace catalog/content observed for the 4.0.1 entry with Codex CLI 0.144.6; no parent model-turn claim

antigravity.discovery_status: historical CLI1.2.9/1.3.1 catalog/content for earlier entries; current catalog/content unavailable through authorized UI; app/IDE unqualified

tools.name: env
tools.description: Saved model environment: new-session, status (gate), discover, save, confirm, check, clear

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Evaluate host prerequisites (Python, Docker, context, image, endpoint, secrets) in one pass

tools.name: secrets
tools.description: Manage inference and stage-referenced application credentials in the owner-only host store (set, status, clear)

tools.name: status
tools.description: Inspect live running child session, turns, tokens, elapsed time, and 80% budget warnings

tools.name: extend-budget
tools.description: Queue bounded budget revisions; --wait-seconds reports host application separately from child observations

tools.name: steer
tools.description: Queue guidance for the next linked process; optional parent-applied interrupt, with assisted attribution

tools.name: patch-session
tools.description: Patch a quiescent pending stage under a host writer lease; active/completed stages reject

tools.name: run
tools.description: Execute a full multi-stage agentic plan with isolated container stages

tools.name: validate-plan
tools.description: Offline reviewed plan structure

tools.name: validate-agent-profile
tools.description: Offline reviewed fixture profile contract; does not load components

tools.name: validate-experiment
tools.description: Offline fixed cases/scorer/matrix validation

tools.name: experiment-prepare
tools.description: Freeze complete inputs and intended matrix offline

tools.name: experiment-run
tools.description: Collect fresh serial trials with bounded scoring after eligible failures

tools.name: experiment-resume
tools.description: Reconcile owned cleanup and run pending cells; explicit retry-trial creates linked attempt

tools.name: experiment-export
tools.description: Deterministic complete trial records with missingness/retries

tools.name: experiment-report
tools.description: Primary denominators, eligible pairs and linked comparison evidence

tools.name: preflight
tools.description: Container endpoint/model/context checks

tools.name: smoke
tools.description: Real paired tool-use challenge plus independent verifier

tools.name: browser-check
tools.description: Credential-free bounded DOM/JavaScript and observed namespace/seccomp admission; explicit pinned ARM64 browser policy

tools.name: pr-review-gate
tools.description: Parent-host read-only GitHub exact-head review/readiness gate; requires authenticated gh CLI and never merges
tools.command: python3 scripts/pi_lab.py pr-review-gate --repo OWNER/REPOSITORY --pr 1 --head VERIFIED_HEAD_SHA --expect-reviewer Copilot

exit_codes.0: Clean autonomous PASS, command success or ready
exit_codes.1: Failed, assisted or recovered run; command error
exit_codes.2: Blocked or interrupted run; validation failure
exit_codes.3: doctor/secrets: missing key; run/smoke records BLOCKED/2
exit_codes.11: env status: saved environment awaits confirmation in this session
exit_codes.12: env status: environment failed its live check

security_scope.mounts: read-only root/helpers/controls; configured project access; writable isolated runtime/outbox
security_scope.bash_filter: additional pattern guard, not a full shell parser
security_scope.pi_offline: disables startup network operations; Docker network mode controls routing

metadata_role: Supplemental package descriptor; SKILL.md is the discovery entry
discovery_evidence_scope: Version-scoped workspace catalog and selected-content observations only. Direct CLI help and installation are separate checks; no automatic invocation or parent model-turn claim.
